india.one_line: India joined supply chain protection efforts, SEBI announced capital market AI rules, and MeitY launched DPDP consent manager registration.

themes.title: India joins international AI supply chain accord
themes.text: India joined the US, Japan, and the UK in agreeing to create a joint list of AI technologies and supply chains to protect from China.

stories.headline: US and allies agree to create joint list to protect AI supply chains from China

themes.title: SEBI plans capital market AI guidelines
themes.text: SEBI chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey announced upcoming guidelines for AI use in securities markets, focusing on disclosures, accountability, and human-in-the-loop controls.

stories.headline: Sebi to issue AI usage guidelines for capital markets focusing on investor protection

themes.title: MeitY opens DPDP consent manager portal
themes.text: MeitY opened an online portal for companies to register as consent managers under the DPDP Act, requiring a minimum net worth of ₹2 crore.

stories.headline: MeitY opens DPDP Act consent manager registration portal
